final_message:
The yen receipt test passes now. `npm test` runs 18 tests, all passing.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100 and printed two decimals. Yen has no minor unit, so `500` was shown as `¥5.00` instead of `¥500`.

**Fix:** I added a `ZERO_DECIMAL` set containing `JPY`. For those currencies the helper divides by 1 and prints zero decimals. Other currencies are unchanged. This also affects the invoice line and cart total formatters, which share this helper, so yen amounts there now display whole units too.

I didn't commit anything. The only changed file is `src/utils/money.js`.
